scope: Read-only independent review of every full Reading and all exact before/after replacements in group-a.json against the second-pass baseline, the initial baseline for original intent and prior differences, and current source files.
conclusion: No concrete loss or addition of meaning requiring correction was found. Private motive/fear/gift intensity, historical attribution and interpretive scope, drink mechanics, specific imagery and distinct voices are preserved across the substantive editorial changes.

verification.audit_replay: All 91 replacements replay uniquely and exactly to the current source files.
verification.protected_regions: Source before ## Reading and from ## Dossier onward matches both snapshots byte-for-byte.
verification.approval: Approved creator-hero remains wholly identical to the initial source.
verification.protected_fragments: All 67 applicable exact protected fragments that occur in the original guest Reading remain.
verification.schema_numbers_signature: Numbered paragraph markers, numeric sequences and I like to think signature counts match the second-pass snapshot.
verification.quotations: Exact quoted text is preserved as a multiset. Creator-lover moves “nice” before “no” within the comparison, without altering either quote or its emotional ranking.
verification.manual_scope: Each edited sentence was reviewed in paragraph and full-reading context for history caveats, causal intent, chronology, sensory scope and proposal.
verification.execution: No source edits, project validators, importer or other project modules were run.
